project_tracker_diagnostic: Annual, usually taprooted; broad rough ovate-triangular usually serrate leaves with conspicuous petioles and often 3 strong basal veins; branching variable; broad abruptly tapering phyllaries.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.life_cycle: Annual herb, usually with a taproot; do not use a single year's appearance alone to infer lifecycle.
morphology_keys.habit: Coarse, erect, stiff-hairy stems; often branching, though some wild plants and cultivated forms are little-branched.
morphology_keys.leaf_arrangement: Lower leaves sometimes opposite; much of stem often alternate. Arrangement alone cannot separate this from H. maximiliani.
morphology_keys.leaves: Representative mid-stem leaves broadly ovate to triangular, often heart-based; rough, usually prominently serrate and visibly petiolate (petioles ca. 2–20 cm).
morphology_keys.leaf_venation: Usually 3 conspicuous veins arising from or near the leaf base; blade is generally flat, not narrow and V-folded.
morphology_keys.leaf_attachment: Longer petiole is readily visible; compare several mature mid-stem nodes against Maximilian's sessile/short-petioled leaves.
morphology_keys.heads: Wild forms typically 1–9 heads, usually terminal on stem or branches; very large cultivated flower heads and strongly branched forms vary.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: Broad ovate to lance-ovate bracts (often 5–8 mm wide) with abruptly acuminate tips, hairy/ciliate edges; check side or underside of a mature head.
morphology_keys.fruit: Flattened cypselas usually bearing a pair of deciduous scales/awns; shared character, not the key split from Maximilian.
best_field_traits: broad, commonly toothed, petiolate leaf: inspect a mid-stem blade
3 strong veins from near leaf base
coarse rough annual stem; branching may vary
broad phyllaries with rather abruptly narrowed tips

diagnostic_comparison.look_first: Mid-stem leaf: broad + stalked + commonly toothed + 3 strong basal veins = H. annuus; check several nodes.
diagnostic_comparison.confirm_with: Compare underside of flowering head: broader phyllaries with more abrupt pointed ends in H. annuus.
diagnostic_comparison.caution: Disk color, yellow rays, height, branching and opposite/alternate leaf arrangement alone are unreliable.

source_audit.scope: Morphology and pairing only. County native-range status left unchanged.
